subject: Aligning Solstice POC demo with FY planning window and exec travel
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Diaz <maria.diaz@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Aligning POC demo timing and participants

Hi Maria —

Following up from our call last week. Quick note to propose a couple of demo windows for the Solstice POC and to surface a few constraints on our side: currently we have availability the weeks of Nov 17 and Nov 29 for a full product walkthrough + exec Q&A. I attached a lightweight mutual-action-plan and the pre-demo slide deck so you can share with your team.

Two questions for you:
- Do you have any blackout dates in the middle of November for execs/finance?
- What is your procurement timeline (PO / SOW) — would we need a signed PO before a production trial?

If November is a hard freeze for Solstice, we can either (A) do a very short technical deep-dive with engineering this week and record the exec-facing section for later, or (B) push everything to early December. Both are feasible but we'd like to lock dates so our engineering and CS folks can block time.

Thanks — attached: mutual-action-plan.xlsx, pre-demo-slide-deck.pdf

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0198
From: Maria Diaz <maria.diaz@solsticehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@solsticehealth.com>, Jared Cole <jared.cole@solsticehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning POC demo timing and participants

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the materials. Quick update on our side: our CFO and the head of procurement will be traveling the week of Nov 16–20 and Finance has initiated an FY planning freeze from Nov 15–30. That means exec-level decisions and PO approvals are likely to be postponed until early December.

Two suggestions:
1) We can do a 30–45 minute technical walk with our engineering and security leads (no CFO) this Thursday or Friday — that would let the architects validate fit and unblock technical questions.
2) For executive and procurement review, can we look at the week of Dec 6 or Dec 13 for the full walkthrough + procurement checklist review? Procurement has asked that any SOW/PO conversations be tabled until the freeze lifts; I looped them on this email.

Also, procurement would appreciate the SOC2 evidence (or summary) ahead of the exec session — can you send that?

Best,
Maria Diaz
Director of Technology Programs | Solstice Health
maria.diaz@solsticehealth.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Diaz <maria.diaz@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning POC demo timing and participants

On Mon, Nov 09, 2026 at 01:02 PM Maria Diaz <maria.diaz@solsticehealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the materials. Quick update on our side: our CFO and the head of procurement will be traveling the week of Nov 16–20 and Finance has initiated an FY planning freeze from Nov 15–30.

Thanks for the heads up, Maria — sorry to hear about the freeze; totally understand.

Proposal to keep momentum:
- Option A (short-term): Run a 30-minute technical deep-dive with your engineering/security leads this Friday (Nov 12) to validate integration and performance. We'll record the exec portion so you can surface it internally during the freeze.
- Option B (long-term): Book the full executive + procurement session for the week of Dec 6 (we have Dec 7 and Dec 9 open) — that gives your team time to finish the FY planning window.

Neha (CS), can you own the technical session with our infra engineer and include a 10–15 minute SOC2/compliance block? Ben and Laura — can you confirm if Dec 7 or Dec 9 looks better for the exec meeting?

If procurement needs a placeholder SOW to start internal routing, we can provide a non-binding draft and a DocuSign link to let legal route the doc later (no signature required until freeze lifts).

Thanks,
Karthik
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Diaz <maria.diaz@solsticehealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning POC demo timing and participants

Karthik / Maria — happy to run the technical session.

I can host a 30-minute call on Thu, Nov 12 at 11:00 AM PT (30 min) for your engineering and security team. Agenda:
- 5 min intros and scope
- 15 min architecture / integration demo (KV caching, latency profiles, routing rules)
- 10 min SOC2/compliance Q&A

I've attached a one-page compliance summary for procurement (compliance-summary-soc2.pdf). If you want more artifacts we can share the SOC2 binder through the portal after an NDA.

If the Nov 12 slot works, I'll send a calendar invite and include the recorder link. For the exec session post-freeze, we recommend Dec 2 or Dec 9; either works on our side but Dec 2 may be preferable to align with your internal review cycles.

Neha Kapoor
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
From: Maria Diaz <maria.diaz@solsticehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@solsticehealth.com>, Jared Cole <jared.cole@solsticehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning POC demo timing and participants

Neha / Karthik —

Nov 12 at 11:00 AM PT works for our engineering lead (Jared) — please send the calendar invite. We'll treat this as the technical validation and will share notes with the CFO when they return.

For the exec/procurement slot, let's tentatively lock Dec 2 for the full walkthrough and procurement checklist review. Procurement asked that any PO conversations be targeted for the week after (they aim to issue a PO by Dec 10 if everything looks good). I've cc'd procurement on this thread for visibility.

Thanks for being flexible — attaching the meeting attendees on our side: Maria Diaz, Jared Cole (Engineering Lead), procurement@solsticehealth.com.

Best,
Maria
Attachments referenced in thread: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet), pre-demo-slide-deck.pdf (presentation), compliance-summary-soc2.pdf (doc).
